papers.title: Predictive models for physical and mechanical properties of Ti6Al4V produced by Selective Laser Melting
papers.first_author_affiliation: Centre for Micro-Electro Mechanical Systems (CMEMS), University of Minho, Campus de Azurém, 4800-058 Guimarães, Portugal

corresponding_authors.name: F. Bartolomeu
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Centre for Micro-Electro Mechanical Systems (CMEMS), University of Minho, Campus de Azurém, 4800-058 Guimarães, Portugal

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了激光选区熔化Ti6Al4V的力学性能预测模型，对理解工艺-性能关系有借鉴意义，但未涉及应力遮挡、多孔结构或疲劳性能。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structures, stress shielding, fatigue properties, or as-built surface morphology specific to biomedical implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 建立SLM Ti6Al4V物理与力学性能的预测模型，优化工艺参数。
summary_zh.method: 基于工艺参数（激光功率、扫描速度等）发展回归或机器学习预测模型。
summary_zh.result: 模型能够准确预测致密度、硬度和拉伸强度等性能。
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验测量（金相、硬度、拉伸测试）验证模型精度。

summary_en.motivation: To develop predictive models for the physical and mechanical properties of selective laser melted Ti6Al4V as a function of process parameters.
summary_en.method: Regression and/or machine learning models were established correlating key SLM parameters (laser power, scan speed, etc.) with output properties.
summary_en.result: The predictive models achieved high accuracy in estimating density, hardness, and tensile strength of the manufactured parts.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation was performed using metallographic analysis, hardness testing, and tensile tests on fabricated specimens.
